acip: RAB RIB DANG BRAL BA'I MIG SHES LA, RAB RIB CAN LA SNANG BA'I SKRA SHAD DU SNANG BA MED KYANG, SNANG BA DE MED MI DGOS PAS SANGS RGYAS DANG MI 'DRA'O,,
english: There is no such thing as something making its appearance as the strand of hair that appears to a person who has cataracts, as one which appears to a person whose visual consciousness is free of such cataracts. Nonetheless, it is not the case that the appearance would have to be something that did not exist; thus the case is different from that with an Enlightened Being.
